AppliedAdjustment.description: One adjustment applied to a year (R11).

kind.description: The kind of Appendix C, for example `operating_cash`.

line.description:
For a `lease` adjustment, which of its amounts this entry moves: `asset`, `liability`,
`prepayment`, `equity_effect`, `payments`, `depreciation` or `interest`; for a
`debt_like_provision` of the employee severance indemnity, `interest_cost` on the entry
that moves its interest cost out of B9 (P2); omitted otherwise.

source.description: JSON pointer of the source aggregate.

Assignment.description: One aggregate given, assigned to its destination before the adjustments (R11).

aggregate.description: JSON pointer of the input aggregate.

reference.description: Statutory reference, for example "B.III" or "liabilities D, remainder".

excess_cash.description: Cash of the net financial position: C.IV less operating cash, in currency units.

non_operating_assets.description:
In the type `dcf.fcff` takes, never part of invested capital; amounts in currency
units.

non_operating_assets_total.description: Σ non-operating assets, in currency units.

operating.description: The operating block, up to invested capital.

sources.description: Equity, quasi-equity, net financial position and debt-like items.

total_funds_invested.description:
Invested capital + Σ non-operating assets, in currency units, signed; equals
`total_sources`.

BridgeClaim.description:
A claim on the value of the company other than the net financial position, subtracted from
enterprise value to reach equity value: a debt-like item or a non-controlling interest
(R25). Fairmark subtracts the amount as given and does not choose how it is measured.

basis_note.description:
Free text that qualifies the basis, for example "net of tax" or "49% of the book value
of equity of the subsidiary"; required with `other`, optional otherwise, never empty
when given. Reported, never used in the calculation.

label.description:
What the claim is, for example "Unfunded pension obligation" or "30% of Subsidiary A".
Not empty.

measurement_basis.description:
How the amount was measured, stated by the analyst: `book_value`, `market_value`,
`fair_value`, `present_value` or `other` (then describe it in `basis_note`). Required,
no default. Reported with the amount, never used in the calculation.

value.description: Amount at the valuation date, in currency units, zero or more; subtracted.

Check.description: One relation of R7 or R12 in the result.

pointers.description:
JSON pointers of the inputs on both sides of the relation: for a relation checked, the
items read. Empty for `funds_invested_equals_sources` of a statutory year, whose sides
are computed outputs; its status counts the items taken as zero (D1, M2).

CheckStatus.description: Outcome of one relation. A relation whose sides differ is not an outcome: it is `FM-E026`.

oneOf.description: Both sides given and equal.
A side is missing: the relation could not be checked.

CurrentNonCurrent.description: Current and non-current amounts with the field names of the SPEC-0007 inputs (R15).

current_assets.description:
Current assets (C less C.II beyond one year and item A within it, plus assets D within
one year), in currency units.

current_liabilities.description: Liabilities due within one year (B, C, D, E), in currency units.

fixed_assets.description: Non-current assets (B, C.II and assets D beyond one year), in currency units.

non_current_liabilities.description: Liabilities due beyond one year (B, C, D, E), in currency units.

total_assets.description: Fixed + current assets: total assets less subscribed capital unpaid, in currency units.

Date.description: Calendar date, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 to 2199-12-31.

Destination.description: Where an aggregate, or the part of it moved by an adjustment, goes (Appendix A, B, C).

oneOf.description: Operating fixed assets, in invested capital.
Operating working capital, in invested capital.
Operating provisions, deducted in invested capital.
Non-operating assets, outside invested capital, for the bridge.
Gross debt of the net financial position.
Cash of the net financial position.
An other item of the net financial position, an asset (negative in it).
An other item of the net financial position, a liability (positive in it).
Quasi-equity items, among the sources next to equity.
Debt-like items, for the bridge.
Equity.
Deducted from equity (subscribed capital unpaid).
Value of production, layer of the income statement (A1 to A5, core).
External costs, deducted in value added (B6, B7, B8, B11, B14, core; E1).
Deducted in EBITDA (B9).
Depreciation and amortisation, below EBITDA (B10 a and b, lease depreciation).
Other charges below EBITDA (B12, B13; B10 d with the treatment `operating`; E2).

Income from operating investments, below EBITDA and in operating profit (C15 when
financial fixed assets are wholly `operating` for the year; P2).

Investing result, below operating profit (A5 and B14 investing parts, C15 unless
operating, C16, D18, D19; B10 c and B10 d with the treatment `investing`).
Non-recurring result (parts moved by `non_recurring` adjustments).

Financing result (C17, C17-bis; the interest cost of a debt-like employee severance
indemnity, P2).
Income taxes, item 20 as given.

Removed from its aggregate by the financial-method restatement of a lease and replaced
by depreciation and interest (lease payments out of B8, R21).

Form.description: The form a year was given in (R6: every output states its form).

oneOf.description: Aggregates of art. 2424 and 2425 (Appendix A).
Totals already reclassified (Appendix B).

IncomeStatement.description:
The reorganised income statement (Appendix B.2; R16 to R20). Amounts named after a
statutory item are the core amounts that enter the layers: less the parts moved by
adjustments, with lease depreciation and interest added (R21).

depreciation_and_amortisation.description:
Depreciation and amortisation (B10 a and b, core, plus B10 c when it is operating, P1,
plus lease depreciation), in currency units; the field of `FreeCashFlowLines`.

ebitda.description:
EBITDA (margine operativo lordo, MOL): value added − personnel costs, in currency units,
signed.

ebitda_definition.description: The definition of `ebitda` in words, usable as `ebitda_definition` of SPEC-0007 (R18).

external_costs.description: External costs: B6 + B7 + B8 + B11 + B14, core (E1), in currency units, signed.

financing_result.description:
C17-bis − C17 (core, with lease interest) − the interest cost of a debt-like employee
severance indemnity (P2), in currency units, signed.

income_from_operating_investments.description:
Income from operating investments: C15 (core) when financial fixed assets (B.III) are
wholly `operating` for the year, zero otherwise (P2), in currency units.

income_taxes.description: Item 20 as given, in currency units, signed (positive for a tax charge).

interest_and_other_financial_charges.description: C17 (core, plus lease interest), in currency units.

investing_result.description: Investing result (risultato della gestione accessoria), in currency units, signed.

materials_consumed.description: Materials consumed (B6 + B11, core), in currency units, signed.

net_income.description: Profit before tax − income taxes, in currency units, signed.

non_recurring_result.description:
Σ non-recurring income − Σ non-recurring charges, in currency units, signed; zero when no
item is labelled non-recurring, null when the year gives no income statement (E6).

operating_profit.description:
Operating profit of the core business (reddito operativo della gestione caratteristica,
MON; IFRS 18 "operating profit or loss"): EBITDA − depreciation and amortisation − other
charges below EBITDA + income from operating investments, in currency units, signed.

other_charges_below_ebitda.description:
Other charges below EBITDA: B12 + B13 (+ B10 d with the treatment `operating`), core
(E2), in currency units.

personnel_costs.description: Personnel costs (B9, core), in currency units.

profit_before_financing_and_taxes.description:
Operating profit + investing result (reddito operativo aziendale, EBIT in Italian
practice; IFRS 18 "profit or loss before financing and income taxes"), in currency
units, signed.

profit_before_tax.description:
Profit before financing and taxes + non-recurring result + financing result, in
currency units, signed.

reconciliations.description:
The reconciliations of `operating_profit` and `profit_before_financing_and_taxes` with
A − B (statutory form only).

value_added.description: Value added: value of production − external costs, in currency units, signed.

value_of_production.description: Value of production (A1 to A5, core), in currency units, signed.

Layout.description: The statutory layout, echoed in the result; no number depends on it.

oneOf.description: Ordinary layout, art. 2424 and 2425 of the Civil Code.
Abridged layout, art. 2435-bis.
Micro-entity layout, art. 2435-ter.

Line.description: A labelled amount, for example an asset and its realisable value.

label.description: What the amount is, for example "Land" or "Bank loan". Not empty.

value.description: Amount in currency units, zero or positive.

MeasurementBasis.description:
How the amount of a bridge claim was measured (Decision 21). Fairmark does not choose the
basis: the analyst states it and the result reports it next to the amount.

oneOf.description: Book value per the accounts at the valuation date.
Quoted market price at the valuation date.
Fair value as defined by IFRS 13.
Present value of the obligation, for example unfunded pensions or provisions.
Another basis, described in `basis_note` (required).

NetFinancialPosition.description:
The net financial position with its composition (SPEC-0007 R6). Fairmark adds what is
given and does not choose which items are included.

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents, in currency units, subtracted from the gross debt.

gross_debt.description: Gross financial debt (bank loans, bonds and other borrowings), in currency units.

other_items.description: Other items included by the analyst, each added with its sign. Default: none.

NetFinancialPositionBlock.description:
The net financial position in the SPEC-0007 type, with its total, maturities and
composition (R13).

current.description: Part due within one year, in currency units, signed.

non_current.description: Part due beyond one year, in currency units, signed.

position.description: The SPEC-0007 object, accepted unchanged by `ratios.*` and `dcf.fcff`.

total.description: Gross debt − cash + other items, positive for net debt, in currency units, signed.

NfpComponent.description: One component of the net financial position, with its source and maturities (R13).

amount.description:
Amount added to the net financial position, in currency units, signed (negative for an
asset).

current.description:
Part due within one year, in currency units, signed; null when its maturity split is not
given.

label.description: What the component is, for example "Cash (C.IV)".

non_current.description:
Part due beyond one year, in currency units, signed; null when its maturity split is not
given.

source.description: JSON pointer of the input it comes from (an aggregate or an adjustment).

NfpItem.description: One item of the net financial position other than gross debt and cash.

amount.description:
Amount in currency units, added to the net financial position: positive for debt-like
items, negative for financial assets.

name.description: What the item is, for example "lease liabilities" or "derivative assets".

NotComputed.description: The outputs not computed, one list per block, sorted by output pointer.

balance_sheet.description: Outputs of the balance sheet block.

current_non_current.description: Outputs of the current and non-current block.

income_statement.description: Outputs of the income statement block.

NotComputedEntry.description: An output not computed, with the pointers of its missing inputs.

missing.description: JSON pointers of the inputs it needs and lacks, sorted.

output.description: JSON pointer of the output in the result value.

permitted.description: For a missing treatment, its permitted destinations; omitted otherwise.

reason.description: Why the output is not computed, one sentence; omitted when the method gives none.

invested_capital.description:
Operating fixed assets + operating working capital − operating provisions, in currency
units, signed.

operating_fixed_assets.description: Operating fixed assets, in currency units.

operating_provisions.description: Provisions and employee severance indemnity treated as operating, in currency units.

operating_working_capital.description: Operating working capital, in currency units, signed.

trade_working_capital.description: Trade receivables + inventories − trade payables, in currency units, signed.

oneOf.description: The fixed or default destination of Appendix A.
A treatment or an override stated by the analyst.

Permitted.description: A missing treatment and the destinations it permits (SPEC-0005 R8).

treatment.description: JSON pointer of the treatment to give.

Reconciliation.description:
A subtotal reconciled with the statutory difference between value and costs of production
(R19): `start` + Σ `lines` = `end`, exactly.

end.description: The subtotal reconciled, in currency units, signed.

lines.description:
Every amount moved, in the order: write-downs, then adjustments in the order given, then
the investing items.

start.description: A − B of the statutory income statement, in currency units, signed.

ReconciliationLine.description: One amount moved between A − B and a subtotal (R19).

amount.description: Amount added to A − B, in currency units, signed.

label.description: What the amount is, for example "B10 c, write-downs of fixed assets (investing result)".

sources.description:
JSON pointers of the inputs actually read for it: an aggregate (both D18 and D19 when
both are read; the B10 a to c group when B10 c is read as none, with B10 a, b when
B10 c is derived from them), or the amount of an adjustment for the year
(`/adjustments/<k>/amounts/<i>`, its `payments` or `depreciation` for a lease,
`/adjustments/<k>/interest_cost/<i>` for an interest cost).

Reconciliations.description: The reconciliations of the two IFRS 18 aligned subtotals with A − B (R19).

debt_like_items.description:
In the type of the `dcf.fcff` bridge, at carrying amount (`book_value`), amounts in
currency units.

debt_like_items_total.description: Σ debt-like items, in currency units.

equity.description:
Equity after subscribed capital unpaid and dividends declared, in currency units,
signed.

net_financial_position.description: The net financial position (SPEC-0007 type) with its total, parts and composition.

quasi_equity_items.description: Quasi-equity items, each a label and an amount in currency units.

quasi_equity_items_total.description: Σ quasi-equity items, in currency units.

total_sources.description:
Equity + quasi-equity + net financial position + debt-like items, in currency units,
signed.

adjustments_applied.description: Every adjustment applied to the year (R11).

assignments.description: Every aggregate given, with its destination (R11).

checks.description: Every relation of R7 and R12, by id.

current_non_current.description: Current and non-current amounts for SPEC-0007 (R15).

date.description: The balance sheet date, as given.

form.description: `statutory`, `reclassified`, or null when the entry gives neither.

not_computed.description: The outputs not computed, with the inputs they lack (R6).

years.description: One entry per input year, in the same order.
